findings.title: A lone UTF-16 surrogate in the ID token's sub makes the OIDC callback answer an undeclared 400 problem (validation.format) instead of its declared 302 redirect, and the failed sign-in leaves no audit row
findings.reproduction: A lone surrogate is legal in a JSON string escape ('\ud800'), so it survives JSON.parse of the ID token payload. identityClaimsStorable (apps/api/src/modules/identity/oidc.ts) checks only for U+0000. resolveOidcUser inserts user_identity (text: node-postgres sends UTF-8, so the column would receive U+FFFD). It then audits changes { identity: { issuer, subject } } through packages/db/src/audit.ts, whose changes column is JSON.stringify(event.changes). JSON.stringify keeps the lone surrogate as the escape '\ud800', PostgreSQL's jsonb input refuses that escape with SQLSTATE 22P02, and apps/api/src/modules/platform/hooks.ts maps 22P02 to 400 validation.format. Probe: disposable clone at 51a692b1, disposable PostgreSQL 16.13, the candidate's FakeIdp; zz-sec-r6-surrogate.test.ts, run with LANG unset (surrogate-probe-run1.log) and with LANG=C.UTF-8 (probe-run2.log). GET /api/v1/auth/callback with a valid code whose ID token has sub 'r6s-jit-\ud800' (JIT path), or sub 'r6s-bind-\udfff' plus a verified e-mail of a pre-provisioned user (bind path), returns 400 application/problem+json {code: validation, errors: [{pointer: '', code: 'validation.format'}]}. The harness contract check reports 'completeOidcLogin does not declare status 400 (declared: 302, 429)'. The audit_event rows for the request id: none. No identity or session is created, and the login cookie is cleared.
findings.expected: The callback contract (docs/api/openapi.yaml completeOidcLogin: 302, 429; ADR-0007 §5a names it as the only operation without a 400) is honoured for every ID token. A subject or issuer the server cannot store or audit faithfully is refused like the NUL case: 302 /login?error=token_invalid, with a session.login_failed audit row. For example, extend identityClaimsStorable to refuse lone surrogates (e.g. !iss.isWellFormed() || !sub.isWellFormed(), Node 20+), or map the callback's database errors to its declared redirect. Add an oidc.test.ts case. Optionally, apply the same well-formedness check in hasInvalidCharacter so that free text is not silently rewritten to U+FFFD.
findings.actual: Undeclared 400 problem JSON from a browser-navigation endpoint (the user sees a raw JSON error page instead of the login page), and a failed sign-in with no audit row. Integrity and confidentiality hold: the transaction rolls back, no user, identity or session is created, and the body carries only a requestId. On the main API, lone surrogates in free text never give a 5xx (the text columns store U+FFFD; a value that reaches jsonb directly, e.g. a journey step name, gets a declared 400 validation.format at pointer ''), so this is limited to the callback.

history.note: Raised by code-security-reviewer, DG2 round 6, while probing for residuals of the F-DG2-231 class as assigned. Low and non-mandatory, the same rating as F-DG2-231. The input is IdP-issued: it needs the trusted OpenID Provider to sign an ID token whose sub contains a lone surrogate (Keycloak subjects are UUIDs), so an end user cannot trigger it. No integrity, authorization or confidentiality impact: everything rolls back and nothing internal leaks. It is a contract and audit-completeness defect. It does not block the round. F-DG2-231 (U+0000) is verified fixed (CLOSED_VERIFIED).
